# ⛳ GOLF IT! — FREE + CO-OP WITH PIRATES

**SteaMidra download · Golf It! Map Manager · Workshop maps without Steam auth**

> Get Golf It! for free, play online with friends, and share custom maps — even with people who don't own the game.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 1️⃣ Download the Game
**SteaMidra → Store → Golf It!** → **Everyday** / **Hubcap** → **Thru Steam** → **No** (if asked about game updates).
-# New to SteaMidra? Set it up first with the **[SteaMidra guide](https://discord.com/channels/976680631012589610/1542853542719524924)**.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 2️⃣ Install the Map Manager
1. Download **[Golf It! Map Manager](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1_idrB5s4JdFykACAb1uKeRjjIcK-pwPG/view?usp=sharing)**.
2. Extract it anywhere → run `GolfItManager.exe` → **Setup** tab → **Install this app** (or keep it portable).

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 3️⃣ Apply the Online-Fix
1. **Close Steam completely** (Task Manager or the system tray).
2. In GolfItManager's **Setup** tab → **Step 3** → click **Open** and download `Golf.It.v1.0.1.1953-OFME.rar`.
3. **Browse** → select the `.rar` you downloaded → **Extract to Parked Folder**.
4. Scroll to the bottom of the **Setup** tab → **Set it for me**.
5. Make sure **Steam Cloud is turned off** for Golf It!.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 4️⃣ Play
Launch through **Steam** → **Play old**.
> 💡 **How it works:** the manager swaps the 4 bytes that hold each map's Workshop ID for the map name as a custom file, bypassing Steam Workshop auth. As long as everyone has **byte-identical** map files, you can join instantly.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 🗺️ Don't Own the Game / No Workshop?
Complete the setup above first, then:
1. Download the **latest map pack** below.
2. **Share** tab → **Import a Map Pack**.
3. Launch through Steam → **Play old**.
-# Sharing your maps with someone who doesn't own Golf It!? **Share → Export Map Pack** — or share a code/file for Workshop sharing.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 📦 Latest Map Pack
**[12 Maps — golfit-coop-maps-2026-09-20.zip](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1tJZGGbod87h0R-E0pPAe78Zjed3gFYAf/view?usp=sharing)**
